summary: T3 Defense Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce the postponement of its special stockholder meeting from June 18, 2026 to June 24, 2026 at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time. The record date and proposals remain unchanged as described in proxy statements filed on June 1 and June 16, 2026. The virtual meeting link is www.virtualshareholdermeeting.com/DFNS2026SM. This filing is a routine scheduling change and does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. Therefore, it is not a special situation.
